flows.title: Add a page to an app
steps: In AI chat, describe the page you want — for example, Create a new About page with a hero section, text about our company, and a contact button.
When the AI chat has finished, open the new page from the page drop-down above the preview and carry on customising it there.

flows.title: Switch to another page in the editor
steps: Click the page drop-down above the preview.
Click the page you want to open.
In an app with many pages, start typing the page name in the drop-down to search for it.

flows.title: Try an app against test data instead of live data
steps: Click Dashboard in your app editor.
Turn on the Test Data toggle. It builds a new, empty test database; nothing from production is copied into it.
To work with those records, click Dashboard, click Data, click the table you want on the left menu, and click Test at the top.
A published app always reads and writes production data; testing mode reaches only the dashboard and the preview.
